entry.content:
Held annually between 1980 and 2000, the Camel Trophy was a grueling off-road competition held on some of the Earth's most challenging terrain. Land Rovers were used for the majority of those years, including the Range Rover TD for the 1987 Madagascar race. One of those can be seen in this color photo from Martyn Goddard, who captured it being winched out of the Herefordshire mud during training in January 1986. The photo is printed on Fuji crystal archive paper, numbered and certified, and comes encased inside a hand-made solid wood white or black frame that's ready to hang. Limited edition of 495.

entry.content:
A. Lange & Söhne's Datograph Perpetual, the brand's first wristwatch to combine a chronograph, perpetual calendar and outsize date when it debuted in 2006, returns with a 950 platinum case and five-row bracelet. The black dial carries eleven baguette-cut diamond hour markers, with the 4 and 8 o'clock markers left out to make room for rhodium-colored subdials. The hand-wound L952.1 caliber has 556 parts, 223 of them in the calendar, and a column-wheel flyback chronograph that measures to one-fifth of a second, visible through the sapphire caseback. Production is limited to 50 pieces.

entry.title: Fortaleza Reposado Tequila
entry.summary: Traditional tequila-making methods give Fortaleza Reposado its distinctive character, beginning with agave from Mexico's Tequila Valley. Cooked in stone ovens and crushed entirely by stone, the agave ferments in open-air wooden tanks before being double-distilled in copper pots.
entry.content:
Traditional tequila-making methods give Fortaleza Reposado its distinctive character, beginning with agave from Mexico's Tequila Valley. Cooked in stone ovens and crushed entirely by stone, the agave ferments in open-air wooden tanks before being double-distilled in copper pots. Aging in American oak brings notes of caramel, vanilla, and cinnamon to the spirit's natural citrus, cooked agave, and earthy character. The palate is rich and slightly oily, with hints of apple and a long, gently spiced finish. Bottled at 80 proof in hand-blown Mexican glass, it's a compelling example of traditional tequila craftsmanship.

entry.content:
Timex's Marlin Neo Classic Chronograph takes its cue from the mid-century Marlin, a line that debuted in the 1950s and became a centerpiece of Timex's collection in the 1960s. The 40mm case is brushed stainless steel with curved pushers and a polished top ring, and the cream dial pairs metallic blue numerals and hands with a tachymeter scale for reading average speed. Subdials track seconds and a 24-hour clock, and the luminous hands stay readable in low light. The 20mm stainless steel bracelet fastens with a butterfly clasp that folds shut from both sides, and the watch is water resistant to 164 feet, enough for light swimming.
